title: Chào hỏi cơ bản
desc: Học cách chào hỏi trong tiếng Anh hàng ngày
prompt: Hello! I'm your English partner. Let's practice greetings! How would you say hello to a new friend?

title: Giới thiệu bản thân
desc: Tự giới thiệu tên, tuổi, nghề nghiệp
prompt: Hi there! Let's practice introducing ourselves. Please tell me about yourself in English - your name, age, and what you do.

title: Hỏi thăm sức khỏe
desc: How are you? và các biến thể
prompt: Hey! Let's talk about asking how someone is doing. How would you ask me about my day?

title: Cảm ơn và xin lỗi
desc: Thank you, Sorry và các cách nói lịch sự
prompt: Being polite is important! Let's practice saying thank you and sorry. Can you thank me for helping you?

title: Hỏi đường
desc: Chỉ đường và hỏi đường trong thành phố
prompt: Excuse me, I'm lost! Can you help me? Let's practice asking for and giving directions.

title: Mua sắm cơ bản
desc: Hỏi giá, trả giá, thanh toán
prompt: Welcome to my shop! How can I help you today? Let's practice shopping conversations.

title: Gọi điện thoại
desc: Nghe máy, để lại tin nhắn
prompt: *Ring ring!* Hello, this is ABC Company. Let's practice phone conversations!

title: Đặt lịch hẹn
prompt: I'd like to schedule an appointment. Let's practice making and changing appointments.

title: Thương lượng
desc: Đàm phán trong mua bán và công việc
prompt: Let's practice negotiation skills. I'm selling this item for $100. Can you negotiate?

title: Giải quyết khiếu nại
desc: Phàn nàn và xử lý vấn đề
prompt: I'm sorry, but there's a problem with my order. Let's practice handling complaints professionally.

title: Đặt phòng khách sạn
desc: Check-in, check-out, yêu cầu dịch vụ
prompt: Good evening! Welcome to Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation? Let's practice hotel check-in!

title: Tại sân bay
desc: Làm thủ tục, hải quan, cổng bay
prompt: Welcome to the airport! Let's practice airport English. Where are you flying to today?

title: Gọi taxi/Grab
desc: Đặt xe, nói địa điểm, thanh toán
prompt: Hi, I need a ride! Let's practice calling a taxi and giving directions.

title: Tham quan địa điểm
desc: Mua vé, hỏi thông tin, chụp ảnh
prompt: Welcome to the famous museum! Let's practice tourist conversations. What would you like to see?

title: Nhà hàng nước ngoài
desc: Đọc menu, gọi món, thanh toán
prompt: Good evening! Here's our menu. Are you ready to order? Let's practice restaurant English!

title: Mua quà lưu niệm
desc: Hỏi giá, mặc cả, chọn quà
prompt: Looking for souvenirs? Let's practice shopping for gifts in English!

title: Xử lý sự cố du lịch
desc: Mất đồ, lỡ chuyến bay, khẩn cấp
prompt: Oh no! I've lost my passport! Let's practice handling travel emergencies.

title: Du lịch y tế
prompt: I don't feel well. Can you help me? Let's practice medical conversations while traveling.

title: Giới thiệu đồng nghiệp
prompt: Let me introduce you to my colleagues. Let's practice workplace introductions!

title: Email công việc cơ bản
prompt: Let's practice writing professional emails. What kind of email do you need to write?

title: Họp online
desc: Tham gia cuộc họp video call
prompt: Can everyone hear me? Let's practice online meeting phrases and expressions!

title: Thuyết trình công việc
prompt: Today I'd like to present... Let's practice giving presentations in English!

title: Phỏng vấn xin việc
desc: Trả lời câu hỏi phỏng vấn
prompt: Tell me about yourself! Let's practice common job interview questions.

title: Đàm phán lương
prompt: We'd like to offer you the position. Let's discuss your salary expectations.

title: Báo cáo dự án
prompt: Let's go over the project status. How's your work progressing?

title: Speaking Part 1 - Hometown
prompt: Let's practice IELTS Speaking Part 1. Tell me about your hometown.

title: Speaking Part 1 - Work/Study
prompt: Do you work or are you a student? Let's practice describing your occupation.

title: Speaking Part 1 - Hobbies
prompt: What do you like to do in your free time? Let's practice talking about hobbies.

title: Speaking Part 2 - Describe a Person
prompt: Describe a person who has influenced you. You have 1 minute to prepare.

title: Speaking Part 2 - Describe a Place
prompt: Describe a place you would like to visit. You have 1 minute to prepare.

title: Speaking Part 3 - Technology
prompt: How has technology changed the way people communicate? Let's discuss.

title: Speaking Part 3 - Environment
prompt: What can individuals do to protect the environment? Share your thoughts.

title: Office Vocabulary
prompt: Let's learn office vocabulary! What do you call the place where you work?

title: Business Meetings
prompt: The meeting will start in 5 minutes. Let's practice meeting vocabulary!

title: Business Correspondence
prompt: Please find attached... Let's practice formal business writing!

title: Phone Messages
prompt: May I take a message? Let's practice professional phone communication.

title: Contract Discussion
prompt: Let's review the contract terms. What questions do you have?

title: Company Presentation
prompt: Tell me about your company. What products or services do you offer?

title: Classroom English
prompt: Can you repeat that, please? Let's practice classroom language!

title: Asking Questions in Class
prompt: I have a question about... Let's practice asking questions politely.

title: Academic Discussion
prompt: I agree with your point, however... Let's practice academic discussion skills.

title: Research Presentation
prompt: My research focuses on... Let's practice presenting academic work.

title: Thời tiết
desc: Nói về thời tiết hàng ngày
prompt: Nice weather today, isn't it? Let's practice talking about the weather!

title: Gia đình
desc: Giới thiệu gia đình của bạn
prompt: Tell me about your family! How many people are in your family?

title: Sở thích
desc: Chia sẻ những gì bạn thích
prompt: What do you enjoy doing on weekends? Let's talk about hobbies!

title: Kế hoạch tương lai
desc: Nói về dự định và mong muốn
prompt: What are your plans for the future? Let's practice future tense!

title: Kể chuyện quá khứ
desc: Chia sẻ kỷ niệm và trải nghiệm
prompt: Tell me about your last vacation! Let's practice past tense.

title: Đưa ra lời khuyên
prompt: I have a problem... Can you give me some advice?

title: Tranh luận
prompt: Do you think social media is good or bad? Let's debate!

title: Nói về tin tức
prompt: Did you hear about the news? Let's discuss current events!

title: Đổi tiền
prompt: I'd like to exchange some money. Let's practice money-related vocabulary!

title: Hỏi về wifi
prompt: Do you have wifi here? Let's practice tech-related travel phrases!

title: Thuê xe
prompt: I'd like to rent a car. What documents do I need?

title: Mua vé tàu/bus
prompt: One ticket to London, please. Let's practice buying transportation tickets!

title: Bảo hiểm du lịch
prompt: I need to file an insurance claim. Let's practice insurance vocabulary.

title: Nghỉ phép
prompt: I'd like to request some time off. Let's practice leave-related conversations!

title: Chỉ đường trong văn phòng
prompt: Where is the meeting room? Let's practice office directions!

title: Feedback công việc
prompt: Can I give you some feedback? Let's practice constructive criticism.

title: Teamwork
prompt: Let's work together on this project. How should we divide the tasks?

title: Crisis Management
prompt: We have a problem! The deadline is tomorrow. What should we do?

title: Speaking Part 1 - Food
prompt: What kind of food do you like? Do you prefer cooking or eating out?

title: Speaking Part 1 - Transportation
prompt: How do you usually get to work or school? Let's discuss transportation.

title: Speaking Part 2 - Event
prompt: Describe a special event you attended. You have 1 minute to prepare.

title: Speaking Part 3 - Education
prompt: How has education changed in your country? Let's discuss.

title: Speaking Part 3 - Globalization
prompt: What are the advantages and disadvantages of globalization?

title: Company Structure
prompt: Who is your manager? Let's practice organizational vocabulary!

title: Progress Reports
prompt: How is the project going? Let's practice giving updates.

title: Budget Discussion
prompt: We need to review the budget. What are your cost projections?

title: Library English
prompt: I'm looking for a book about... Let's practice library vocabulary!

title: Group Projects
prompt: Who wants to be the group leader? Let's practice teamwork language!

title: Số và ngày tháng
prompt: What's the date today? Let's practice numbers and dates!

title: Màu sắc và hình dáng
prompt: Can you describe this object? Let's practice colors and shapes!

title: So sánh
prompt: Which one is better? Let's practice comparative and superlative adjectives!

title: Diễn tả cảm xúc
prompt: How are you feeling today? Let's practice emotion vocabulary!

title: Idioms thông dụng
prompt: It's raining cats and dogs! Let's learn some popular idioms.

title: Đặt tour
prompt: I'd like to book a city tour. What options do you have?

title: Review khách sạn
prompt: How was your stay? Let's practice writing reviews!

title: Văn hóa địa phương
prompt: What should I know about local customs? Let's discuss cultural etiquette!

title: Giờ làm việc
prompt: What time do you start work? Let's practice work schedule vocabulary!

title: Remote Work
prompt: I'm working from home today. Let's practice remote work language!

title: Leadership
prompt: As the team leader, I think we should... Let's practice leadership language!

title: Speaking Part 1 - Reading
prompt: Do you like reading? What kind of books do you enjoy?

title: Speaking Part 2 - Skill
prompt: Describe a skill you learned that has helped you. You have 1 minute.

title: Speaking Part 3 - Health
prompt: How can people stay healthy in modern life? Let's discuss.

title: Training Sessions
prompt: Welcome to the training session! Let's practice learning at work.

title: Performance Reviews
prompt: Let's discuss your performance this year. What achievements are you proud of?

title: Taking Notes
prompt: How do you take notes in class? Let's practice note-taking vocabulary!

title: Thesis Defense
prompt: What is the main argument of your thesis? Let's practice academic defense!

title: Đồ ăn yêu thích
prompt: What's your favorite food? Let's practice food vocabulary!

title: Công thức nấu ăn
prompt: Can you share a recipe? Let's practice cooking vocabulary!

title: Chụp ảnh du lịch
prompt: Could you take a photo of me? Let's practice photography phrases!

title: Hành lý bị mất
prompt: My luggage is missing! Let's practice handling lost baggage.

title: Networking
prompt: Nice to meet you! What do you do? Let's practice networking!

title: Conflict Resolution
prompt: We seem to have a disagreement. How can we resolve this?

title: Speaking Part 1 - Sports
prompt: Do you play any sports? What's your favorite form of exercise?

title: Speaking Part 3 - Media
prompt: How does media influence young people? Share your thoughts.

title: Office Supplies
prompt: I need some office supplies. Let's practice making requests!

title: Merger Discussion
prompt: Our companies are merging. Let's discuss the transition.

title: Peer Review
prompt: I've read your essay. Let me give you some feedback.

title: Asking for Help
prompt: I don't understand this concept. Can you explain it to me?
